name: Video hero banner
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Video hero banner.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Video source
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for video source. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: MP4 URL
settings.how: Enter the mp4 url. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.

settings.info: Used if no video is set and as MP4 poster.
settings.how: Select or upload an image. Add descriptive alt text and set its focal point in Shopify Files. Check the crop on both desktop and mobile; the image does not change the original file.
